description.value:
At 7th level, as an immediate action, the knight can designate an adjacent ally. Until his next turn, as a free action usable outside of his turn, he may force the next physical attack made against that ally to be made against him instead. Also, until his next turn, attacks against the designated ally, including ones redirected by the knight, gain a penalty equal to (-2, increased by 1 per four knight levels after 7th).

If the ally is willing, the knight may swap his position with theirs without provoking attacks when he uses this ability, either when designating or when affecting an attack. The knight may only redirect attacks before their results are known. The swap's movement does not count for movement-limiting abilities such as defensive stance.
